parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one. You will hear a man reporting his lost travel bag at a train station.

First, you will have some time to look at questions one to ten.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to ten.

Good morning, madam. I lost my travel bag on the train. I was wondering if you could help me.

Of course. Sit down, please.

Thank you very much.

First, let me take some details. What's your name, please?

My name is Paul Smithers.

Smithers. Could you please spell it?

Paul Smithers: S-M-I-T-H-E-R-S.

All right. And when did you find you lost your travel bag?

Yesterday evening. I just finished a whole day's paperwork and took the train to return home. I was completely exhausted.

Yesterday. Today is the fifteenth of July, so it's the fourteenth. You said you were on the train when you lost your bag. Do you remember the number of the coach? Which coach were you in?

What do you mean?

Each coach has different letters represented its unique functions. For example, coach A is for smoking passengers, while coach B is for non-smoking passengers. So do you still remember the number of the coach?

I don't remember the exact letter, but I do recall that I was trying to relax my brain with a cup of coffee. So it must be the buffet car.

Wait a minute. I'll check it up for you. You mean the buffet car? That's the coach E.

Oh, yes. That's it then.

All right. Now tell me something about the bag. What's the color?

It is a brown one with a small blue carton race car image at the bottom in the left-hand corner.

Okay, I know. And what does it look like? What's the style?

What do you mean?

What kind of distinctive features does it have? Like, is it a box type or a soft one? Does it contain any pockets?

Well, it's a soft one on the rack. What's more, there are two pockets at the front. They have long straps and are made by nylon.

Right. Got that. Did you lose any other things besides your bag?

Uh, my jacket, which is made up of leather, and my notebook were in it.

I am sorry to hear it. Do you remember where did you exactly put them?

Well, I walked in the coach, sat down beside my table, ordered my coffee, then, uh, yeah, I found there was not enough space to put my stuff. So I put them by the door, and I forgot to take them when I leave.

Okay, I know. So how much do you think the lost item cost?

Well, my travel bag was about one hundred pounds, but the leather jacket cost me three hundred forty-five pounds, and the notebook, it is not worth much itself, but it contains all the contact I need. It's so frustrating.

We also need your personal information.

No problem. Please.

Where do you live?

Twenty-one Kierke Street. K-I-E-R-K-E Street, Canterbury.

Kierke Street. My cousin also lives there, and I went there sometimes. A quiet street, isn't it?

Yes, indeed. Have you ever been to the park at the corner of the street end? It's very quiet and beautiful. My aunt and uncle like there so much that they go there almost every week.

Not yet, but I'll certainly try there sometime. Uh, let me see. Where were we? Oh, yes, your post code.

GW four three two HA.

Phone number.

Three two one double eight nine two.

Okay. I think that's all we need at the moment. We'll contact you as soon as we have any information on them.

Thank you very much.

You're welcome.

Bye.

Bye.

That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.

analyses.content: 录音提问姓名后，直接给出了完整且清晰的字母拼写 S-M-I-T-H-E-R-S，直接记录即可。
你可能在听到 Paul 后没有准备好记录接下来的姓氏，或者在拼写时漏听字母，一定要熟悉英文字母的读音以快速反应。
First, let me take some details. What's your name, please? My name is Paul Smithers. Smithers. Could you please spell it? Paul Smithers: S-M-I-T-H-E-R-S.
乘客说包是昨天（Yesterday）丢的，随后工作人员明确说明今天是7月15日，因此推算出丢失日期是14号。
你可能容易把最明显听到的“fifteenth”或“yesterday”直接作为答案填上，这里一定要注意根据录音线索进行简单的时间推算陷阱。

And when did you find you lost your travel bag? Yesterday evening. I just finished a whole day's paperwork and took the train to return home. I was completely exhausted. Yesterday. Today is the fifteenth of July, so it's the fourteenth.
乘客回忆自己当时在餐车（buffet car），工作人员随后帮他核对确认了餐车对应的就是车厢E（Coach E）。
你可能在前面听到工作人员举例的 Coach A 或 Coach B 时就急于写上，必须要耐心听完录音里真正的确认环节。

I don't remember the exact letter, but I do recall that I was trying to relax my brain with a cup of coffee. So it must be the buffet car. Wait a minute. I'll check it up for you. You mean the buffet car? That's the Coach E. Oh, yes. That's it then.
顺着对包包类型的提问，乘客清楚地回答这是一个放在行李架（rack）上的软包。
录音语速较快，你可能会因为过于关注包是“soft”而漏听了后面的位置信息，一定要结合卷面介词“on the”预判这里该填位置名词。
Like, is it a box type or a soft one? Does it contain any pockets? Well, it's a soft one on the rack.
顺着关于口袋的提问，乘客补充说明了包的正面有两个口袋（two pockets）。
注意，题目是“one word and a number”，所以这里填数字 2或two是完全符合要求的。另外，你可能只听到了 pockets 这个词却忽略了数量词 two，填空题对于物品的具体数字或数量特征通常要求完整记录。
Does it contain any pockets? Well, it's a soft one on the rack. What's more, there are two pockets at the front.
录音中提到这件夹克衫（jacket）是由皮革（leather）制成的，刚好对应卷面上的材质修饰词。
录音使用了定语从句后置修饰（made up of leather），你可能习惯找前置修饰词而没反应过来，需要防范这种语序倒装替换的陷阱。
Did you lose any other things besides your bag? Uh, my jacket, which is made up of leather, and my notebook were in it.
在提到皮夹克之后，紧接着用 and 连接了丢在包里的另一件物品——笔记本（notebook）。
夹克和笔记本在同一次回答中紧凑出现，你可能还在纠结夹克的材质而错过了接下来的 notebook，遇到并列结构必须保持专注连贯听取。
Did you lose any other things besides your bag? Uh, my jacket, which is made up of leather, and my notebook were in it.
乘客分别报了旅行包（100镑）和皮夹克（345镑）的价格，依据题干“total”（总价值）的要求，两者相加得出答案为445。
你可能会把直接听到的“100”或者干扰项“345”单独填上去，但必须要带着题干“total estimated value”的预判去听，留意要做加法计算。

So how much do you think the lost item cost? Well, my travel bag was about one hundred pounds, but the leather jacket cost me three hundred forty-five pounds, and the notebook, it is not worth much itself, but it contains all the contact I need.
工作人员询问住址后，乘客说出了生僻的街道名称并主动进行了一个字母一个字母的拼写。
街道名拼写比较陌生，你可能在等后面熟悉的 Canterbury 时漏听前面的拼写，务必在听到字母拼写动作时立刻动笔记录。
Where do you live? Twenty-one Kierke Street. K-I-E-R-K-E Street, Canterbury.
工作人员提示需要填写邮政编码（post code）后，乘客直接念出了一串清晰的字母加数字组合，完整抄录即可。
在连续记录字母与数字混合的编码时，你极容易把读音相近的字母（如G和J或W）听混淆，平时必须加强字母与数字的综合听写练习。
Oh, yes, your post code. GW four three two HA.
